_note: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B image-to-video success priors per motion_class. m0 = prior mean (strength 2); ok/n = accumulated outcomes (partial counts 0.5). Seeded from the author's first projects; updated by pipeline.py after every attempt.

atmosphere.notes: clouds/water/light/smoke. Wide scenes with no people can still hallucinate a passer-by (shot 5): add 'people' to the negative prompt.

object.notes: close objects. Later frames can distort (padlock grew a hand at frame ~80): auto-trim by drift.

human_static.notes: seated/lying figures. Motion prompt must only say breathing/candle flicker; a lying figure turned its head. 2026-10-08: a song-MV project's reviews (most of the 24.5/28) only checked hard rules (face, clothes), not whether the motion made sense; the user found many illogical, so this count is optimistic.

human_motion.notes: walking/crowds; distant procession (shot 4) worked, close walking is risky.
